name: Ghost Soul M
storyline: Inheriting the classic Eastern martial arts worldview of Soul Saver Online, Soul Saver M places players in the shoes of a warrior who has lost their memory. Choosing from one of five distinct classes—Warrior, Assassin, Taoist, Titan, or Archer—players embark on an epic adventure to vanquish demons, uphold justice, gradually reclaim their lost memories, and ultimately unveil the hidden truth behind the story.
summary:
Ghost M is a mobile MMORPG developed by the Korean gaming company Mgame, built on the foundation of the classic online game Ghost Online.

Inheriting the original world, the game seamlessly blends Eastern martial arts with supernatural folklore. It features a charming 2D pixel art style, bringing to life adorable chibi characters and flashy combat skills. Players can now dive into the thrill of exorcising demons and conquering the mystical martial world right from their mobile devices!
